chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Abu Masrouq, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said, 'We speak to the people, and we use as proof against them the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority from among you.' But they say, 'It was revealed regarding the commanders of the battalions.'

So we use as proof against them the Word of Him, Mighty and Majestic: 'Only Allah is your Guardian and His Messenger,' up to the end of the verse. But they say, 'It was revealed regarding the believers.'

And we use as proof against them the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Say: I do not ask you for any reward for it except love of kinship.' But they say, 'It was revealed regarding the relatives of the Muslims.'

He said, 'So I did not leave anything that came to my mind from these arguments and similar ones, but I mentioned it. So he said to me: 'When it is like that, call them to the Mubahila (imprecation).''
I said, 'And how should I do it?' He said, 'Prepare yourself for three (days), and I think he said: 'And fast, and perform ghusl, and go out, you and he, to Al-Jabban (the place of meeting).''
So intertwine your fingers from your right hand with his fingers, then be fair with him, and begin with yourself.

And say: 'O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Beneficent, the Merciful. If Abu Masrouq is denying the truth and claiming falsehood, then send down upon him a reckoning from the sky or a painful punishment.'
Then return the supplication upon him, and say: 'And if so-and-so is denying the truth and claiming falsehood, then send down upon him a reckoning from the sky or a painful punishment.'
Then he said to me: 'Indeed, you will not be long before you see that in him. And by Allah, I have not found any creature who will answer me to it.'

key_terms.الْجَبَّان: A specific location or place of meeting for the imprecation
key_terms.الْمُبَاهَلَة: Imprecation / Mutual calling upon God to punish the liar

ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for Mubahila according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi illustrates the practical application of Mubahila in Shia theological debates, specifically addressing the Ismaili and Sunni contention that 'Ulil Amr' and 'Wali' refer to the Caliphs rather than the Imams. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides a precise ritual protocol—including purification and specific finger-linking gestures—demonstrating that the Imams possessed the authority to invoke divine punishment, a power the Caliphs reportedly lacked. This narrative serves as a key epistemological proof for the Imamate, linking scriptural exegesis with miraculous validation.
